principles: Host-neutral experiment control stays outside Codex-specific semantics except for the runner adapter smoke.
Sterility is more important than speed: only allowlisted inputs enter the container.
Probe receipts must be machine-verifiable before any broad Cell06 execution.
Do not optimize or broaden beyond the real correctness risk being tested.
drivers: Avoid contamination from Proofbound memory, Cell03 outputs, and host workspace state.
Represent multi-account sharding without faking a second live account.
Produce compact evidence that can be audited before spending on full Cell06.

options.name: bounded-local-docker-probe
pros: Validates the real container path before full Cell06
Can run with one live auth plus one pending-auth shard placeholder
cons: Does not prove full throughput or full two-account parallelism

options.name: run-full-cell06-now
pros: Would produce formal A2prime rows immediately
cons: Too much blast radius before sterility is proven
Would risk prompt/history contamination and duplicate row accounting

options.name: document-only-checklist
cons: Does not prove Codex CLI works in the container or that scanners reject bad receipts

rationale: A bounded local Docker probe directly tests the concrete correctness risks before full Cell06: container execution, sterile inputs, account/shard ownership, receipt shape, and contamination rejection, while avoiding premature broad provider execution.

preMortem.scenario: Container accidentally sees host memory or Cell03 files
preMortem.trigger: Broad bind mount or copied repo tree
preMortem.consequence: A2prime control is contaminated and unusable
preMortem.mitigation: Mount only generated sterile inputs/output/auth temp directories and validate visible file inventory

preMortem.scenario: Second account path is silently faked
preMortem.trigger: No second auth bundle but validator reports two live accounts
preMortem.mitigation: Receipt status must distinguish live account-a from pending-auth/account-b placeholder

preMortem.scenario: Probe receipts look valid despite contamination
preMortem.consequence: Full Cell06 launch would inherit bad evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Add negative-control receipt/row fixtures and require validator rejection

preMortem.trigger: Loop keeps adding rows after smoke success
preMortem.consequence: Consumes budget and pollutes formal data before launch
preMortem.mitigation: Hard-code small probe row limit and mark full Cell06 as excluded scope
